summary.text: Gabe Evans is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Colorado's 8th District, elected in 2024 after defeating Democratic incumbent Yadira Caraveo. He is an Army veteran and former Arvada police lieutenant who served one term in the Colorado House of Representatives. In his Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running on crime, the cost of living, and keeping Colorado affordable and safe.

paragraphs.text: Born in Aurora, Colorado, and the grandson of Mexican immigrants, according to his official biography and Ballotpedia. Earned a bachelor's degree in government from Patrick Henry College in 2009.

Served in the U.S. Army and Colorado Army National Guard from 2007 to 2019. According to his official biography, he was a UH-60 Black Hawk pilot and company commander stationed at Buckley Air Force Base, completed a combat deployment in support of Operation Enduring Freedom, and reached the rank of captain.
Joined the Arvada Police Department in 2011 and rose to lieutenant, retiring in 2022 to run for public office. He has also worked as a concealed-carry firearms instructor.
Owns and operates a family farm in southern Weld County with his wife, Anne, according to his official biography; they have two sons.

Elected to the Colorado House of Representatives (District 48) in 2022 and served from 2023 to 2025. According to Wikipedia, he focused on criminal justice issues, including bills on time off for National Guard service.

Announced his candidacy for Colorado's 8th District in September 2023, defeated former state Representative Janak Joshi in the Republican primary, and won the November 2024 general election over incumbent Yadira Caraveo, 49.0% to 48.2%.
Serves in Congress on the Energy and Commerce Committee and the Homeland Security Committee, according to Wikipedia; he is a member of the Problem Solvers Caucus.
Ballotpedia lists past affiliations with Destiny Church in Fort Lupton, the National Rifle Association, and Veterans of Foreign Wars.
